_: The reign's ending (reign_cards.gd). ledger: the words of the reign's ledger page on the end card (Civilization's and Total War's end-of-campaign summary, as a chronicle page): its title, the two column heads, each measure's name, the towns' three lines and the rulings' head. The numbers come from the bridge (reign.js ledger).

pause._: The pause menu Esc opens in play (title.gd show_pause): its head and the words on its own buttons.
pause.title: The realm waits

loading._: The loading card while a chronicle is laid out (title.gd _loading_card): line under the heading; tip_head over the Hand's counsel; tips, one shown at a time, a new one every tip_seconds.
loading.line: The land is laid out and the great houses take their seats.
tips: Every house remembers how you ruled on its petition. Kindness is remembered too, but not as long.
A seal spent on one need is a seal not spent on another. Choose what you can live without.
A town that goes hungry blames its lord first, and its King soon after.
A host in the field eats as it marches. Bring it home before the winter does.
A lord who is slighted at court may bow today and bring his banners against you tomorrow.
The tithe is set once a year. The houses feel it every season.
A grudge outlives the King who earned it.
Walls hold a town; bread holds its people. A siege is won by whichever runs out last.
